chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). He said:

Indeed, God -- blessed and exalted -- distinguished His Messenger (may God bless him and his family) with noble character traits. So test yourselves: if they are in you, then praise God, the Mighty and Majestic, and ask Him to increase them in you. He mentioned them as ten: certainty, contentment, patience, gratitude, forbearance, good character, generosity, protectiveness, courage, and chivalry.

key_terms.المروءة: Al-Muru'ah - chivalry, manly virtue encompassing dignity and honor
key_terms.اليقين: Al-Yaqin - certainty, firm faith without doubt
key_terms.مكارم الأخلاق: Makarim al-Akhlaq - noble character traits, the highest moral virtues

ai.seo_question: What are the ten noble character traits of Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq enumerates the ten noble character traits (makarim al-akhlaq) that God bestowed upon Prophet Muhammad: certainty, contentment, patience, gratitude, forbearance, good character, generosity, protectiveness, courage, and chivalry. He urges believers to examine themselves for these traits and to ask God for increase in them. This hadith, reported in the assembly of al-Saduq, provided a practical moral checklist for the early Shia community.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from `Uthman b. `Isa from `Abdullah b. Muskan from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as).  He said:

Surely, Allah distinguished His Messenger (s) with noble character (makarim al-akhlaq). So, test yourselves – if you have [some of] it, then praise Allah and wish for Him to increase it in you. They are ten [characteristics]: (1) certainty, (2) contentment, (3) patience, (4) gratitude, (5) forbearance, (6) beautiful character, (7) generosity, (8) protectiveness, (9) courage, and (10) chivalry.
